recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes a malformed current core Bundle deprecation marker that directly affects the approved deprecated-content mechanism, without duplicating or changing the already-correct Extension Pack definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-38939 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested a visible, structured mechanism for deprecated content: correct the standards-status Deprecated definition, add Withdrawn, define a markdown deprecation reason extension for standards-status.valueCode, and apply standards-status plus reason metadata to deprecated Bundle content.
initial_application: The R5 source appears to have applied the issue in c1dda1d5fd, which added corrected standards-status definitions, a markdown-valued structuredefinition-standards-status-reason extension, and deprecated status reason metadata for Bundle.entry.search.mode outcome. The generic standards-status code system and extension definitions were later moved from core source to the FHIR Extension Pack by dd468d4f17.
additional_context: Current Extension Pack source already has the corrected Deprecated definition, Withdrawn code, and markdown status-reason extension. Current core source still owns Bundle, and a later Bundle.signature deprecation commit, 9fe4e8ba2e, introduced an inconsistent reason marker using valueString as a child extension rather than valueMarkdown under standards-status.valueCode. FHIR-I Confluence minutes confirmed the FHIR-38939 resolution, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml so Bundle.signature places structuredefinition-standards-status-reason inside the deprecated valueCode and uses valueMarkdown. No code-system or extension-definition source was changed because those portions are already correct in the Extension Pack, which now owns them.
source_changes: source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml: moved Bundle.signature standards-status-reason under valueCode and changed valueString to valueMarkdown.
